mechanism: Both drugs have nephrotoxic potential and amphotericin B may increase minocycline levels through renal impairment, while minocycline can elevate intracranial pressure which may be exacerbated by amphotericin B's systemic effects.
action: Monitor renal function closely, maintain adequate hydration, and consider alternative antifungal agents if possible; ensure baseline and periodic assessment of serum creatinine and electrolytes.
